explanation.text:
Your product is likely to meet the AfCFTA rules of origin.

Main reasons:
- No imported ingredient is classified in heading 19.01.
- These steps in Ghana are more than simple operations: mashing of malt with hot water in a mash tun (enzymatic conversion) and drum drying of the malt extract with part of the flour.

What to do next:
- Keep your supplier declarations, invoices and production records together.
- You decide whether to apply. GRA Customs and the National AfCFTA Approval Committee make the official decision.
